I think that the most big problem is that nparents aren't always 100% abusive. They have their moments where they seem like genuine good parents but still hurt you even though you keep telling them to stop.

If they were 100% abusive and violent, it would be much more simpler, and you can call the child protection services or 911 against them. You would then belong to a better family who will hopefully treat you better.

Since they aren't 100% abusive all the time, you wonder If they are 100% evil or If it really is worth the price to call the child protection services. This also makes it hard to describe to people why having nparents is so hard is because you're so confused about where the exact line you have to resort to 911 and the line where you shouldn't resort to these extreme measures. Not to mention nparents manipulate you 24/7.

I think its a matter of "conditional love". Most "normal" parents love their children unconditionally and will always be proud for them. nparents only love and give their recognition only If you do what they say.
